item.title: September general meeting agenda posted
item.description: Agenda for the meeting at Trace Manes, including a Bayview Avenue update.
item.content:encoded:
Agenda for the September general meeting at Trace Manes Park fieldhouse. Items include a Bayview Avenue streetscape update from the city, the Committee of Adjustment application on Millwood Road, traffic calming on Rumsey Road, and the annual tree canopy report. Members are asked to submit questions in advance so the executive can prepare answers. Coffee from 7pm, meeting starts at 7:30pm sharp.

The treasurer will also present the half-year accounts, and there will be a short discussion of the proposed changes to the residential parking permit rules affecting streets west of Laird Drive.
